payload.claim: Upgrade case: two consecutive quarters of Americas comparable sales returning to flat-or-positive, with gross margin holding at or above 56% without tariff-refund help. That would be evidence the new CEO and CPO have stabilised the brand, and it would widen the margin of safety on a stable earnings base. Downgrade case: another guidance cut below $10.35B revenue, or underlying EBIT margin (ex tariff refund) falling below 15% on a TTM basis. Either would show the decline running through the fixed-cost base faster than the price implies. Escalation of the integrity gate from Flag would also trigger review.

prediction.reasoning: Lowered guidance of $10.35-10.5B against roughly $11.1B in the last fiscal year implies a 5-7% decline. Q2 revenue was already -4.3% with comps at -9%, so a decline worse than -3% leaves room for a modest beat. This departs sharply from the +2.8% annual growth the price requires and from the archive median of about +5%. The departure is justified by the guidance cut and share loss to Alo and Vuori.
